newsitem.title: USA: Edison Brothers Sept same store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Edison Brothers Sept same store sales off.

text.p: Edison Brothers Stores Inc said Thursday its total company same store sales for September dropped 2.9 percent to $82.7 million from $85.2 million a year ago.
Apparel same store sales fell 3.8 percent in September and footwear same store sales declined 0.9 percent.
Total sales for September were $92.0 million, down 18.4 percent from $112.8 million a year ago.
Edison Brothers said the decline in September sales reflects the fact that it operated 1,913 stores at the end of the month, down from 2,705 at the end of September 1995.

For the year-to-date period, same store sales for the total compay fell 3.5 percent to $671.4 milion from $695.7 million in 1995. Total sales were $708.4 million, down 19.9 percent from $884.2 million in the year-ago period.
Alan Miller, chairman, said September sales results are in line with the company's plan to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization in the spring of 1997.
